competing_explanation: The window may be defined as 30 days from order/purchase date, or a different period such as 14 or 60 days may apply to standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The correct current 30-day full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from the date the customer receives the item.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy states the full-refund window is not 30 days, starts from a different date such as order or purchase date, or does not apply to standard items.
